title: Food Intake by U.S. Household
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


USDA National Household Food Acquisition and Purchase Survey




Domain/topic


Nutrition




Source type


Government dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


USDA - Government agency




Original purpose


To provide data for scientific research on U.S. housesholds’ food choices




Collection method


Survey (2 online surveys administered in-person)




Record-creation event


Survey submitted











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


Survey response




Population or objects represented


U.S. households (11 years-old and higher)




Time period covered


April 2012 - January 2013




Geographic area coverage


United States











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Varies - 11 total datasets




Data types included


IDs per household, numerical, binary, categorical




Direct measurements


Recorded responses




Possible proxy variables


Health statuses, scaled from 1 to 5, best to worst.











Documentation






Documentation found


13 documents for the 11 datasets




Stated collection details


Captures a 7-day period of sampled households’ food purchases. These purchases were recorded by the household members. For eligibility to participate, households were screened twice.
